title: A required permit cannot be held under the existing legal entity's name
thresholds_source: Declared in procedures/_shared/business-unit-establishment-execution/schema.yaml kill_criteria (ADR-0167); activation awaits an asserted permit-holder var round per ADR-0060 §3
notes: Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design (activation convention per ADR-0057). When any required permit cannot be held by the existing entity, the business-unit route may not be viable; escalate to risk-officer, who may recommend switching the establishment mode to new_entity (an audited, reasoned change).
